technique_name: Write a short story about a rivalry between two people
description:
John and Sarah had been rivals for as long as they could remember. They had grown up on the same street in the same small town, but had never been friends. Each one always seemed to outdo the other in school or sports, much to the other's dismay. 

Things finally came to a head during the town's annual summer sports tournament. Both were determined to come out on top, but in the end it was John who emerged victorious. Sarah had never felt so embarrassed and angry. She vowed to get her revenge on
